# Binary floating-point conversions ("Binary floating-point conversions").
# Binary operands and results are Go float64 or float32 literals read with
# Go's semantics (the nearest binary value), including the hexadecimal
# form; +Inf, -Inf and NaN are the specials. Each conversion rounds once
# from the exact value of its operand. The exact value of every rounded
# binary operand is given in a comment so the vector can be checked by
# hand.
#
# No float64 lies within 10^-34 of a power of ten and no float32 within
# 10^-16 (the floats just below every power of ten were enumerated), so
# the carry class does not apply to Float64To128, Float32To64 and
# Float32To128. Decimal operands are far inside the binary exponent range
# only on the To side, so overflow, underflow and clamp do not apply there.

# --- Float64To64 ---

Float64To64 even exact 0.5 -> 0.5
Float64To64 even exact 2 -> 2
Float64To64 even exact 0.125 -> 0.125
Float64To64 even exact 1e20 -> 1.000000000000000E+20
Float64To64 even exact 1e15 -> 1000000000000000
Float64To64 even exact 1e16 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Float64To64 even exact 1e22 -> 1.000000000000000E+22
Float64To64 even exact 123456789 -> 123456789
Float64To64 even exact 1 -> 1
Float64To64 even exact 9007199254740992 -> 9007199254740992
Float64To64 even exact 4503599627370496 -> 4503599627370496
Float64To64 even exact -2.5 -> -2.5
Float64To64 up exact 0.75 -> 0.75
Float64To64 even exact 0x1p-20 -> 9.5367431640625E-7

# 0.1 = 0.1000000000000000055511151231257827021181583404541015625
Float64To64 even inexact 0.1 -> 0.1000000000000000
Float64To64 up inexact 0.1 -> 0.1000000000000001
Float64To64 zero inexact 0.1 -> 0.1000000000000000
Float64To64 down inexact 0.1 -> 0.1000000000000000
Float64To64 away inexact 0.1 -> 0.1000000000000000
Float64To64 down inexact -0.1 -> -0.1000000000000001
Float64To64 up inexact -0.1 -> -0.1000000000000000
# 0.3 = 0.299999999999999988897769753748434595763683319091796875
Float64To64 even inexact 0.3 -> 0.3000000000000000
Float64To64 zero inexact 0.3 -> 0.2999999999999999
# 1e23 = 99999999999999991611392
Float64To64 even inexact 1e23 -> 9.999999999999999E+22
Float64To64 zero inexact 1e23 -> 9.999999999999999E+22
# 1.7976931348623157e308 = 17976931348623157081452742373170435679807056752584499659891747680315726078002853876058955863276687817154045895351438246423432132688946418276846754670353751698604991057655128207624549009038932894407586850845513394230458323690322294816580855933212334087
Float64To64 even inexact 1.7976931348623157e308 -> 1.797693134862316E+308
Float64To64 zero inexact 1.7976931348623157e308 -> 1.797693134862315E+308
# 5e-324 = 2^-1074 = 4.-324
Float64To64 even inexact 5e-324 -> 4.940656458412465E-324
Float64To64 up inexact 5e-324 -> 4.940656458412466E-324
# 123.456 = 123.4560000000000030695446184836328029632568359375
Float64To64 even inexact 123.456 -> 123.4560000000000
Float64To64 up inexact 123.456 -> 123.4560000000001

# 2^-24 = 5.9604644775390625E-8, 2^-23 = 1.1920928955078125E-7
Float64To64 even tie 0x1p-24 -> 5.960464477539062E-8
Float64To64 away tie 0x1p-24 -> 5.960464477539063E-8
Float64To64 zero tie 0x1p-24 -> 5.960464477539062E-8
Float64To64 up tie 0x1p-24 -> 5.960464477539063E-8
Float64To64 down tie 0x1p-24 -> 5.960464477539062E-8
Float64To64 even tie -0x1p-24 -> -5.960464477539062E-8
Float64To64 away tie -0x1p-24 -> -5.960464477539063E-8
Float64To64 up tie -0x1p-24 -> -5.960464477539062E-8
Float64To64 down tie -0x1p-24 -> -5.960464477539063E-8
Float64To64 even tie 0x1p-23 -> 1.192092895507812E-7
Float64To64 away tie 0x1p-23 -> 1.192092895507813E-7
Float64To64 7 tie 0x1p-24 -> 5.960464477539062E-8

# 1e-7 = 9.99999999999999954748111825886258685613938723690807819366455078125E-8
Float64To64 even carry 1e-7 -> 1.000000000000000E-7
Float64To64 away carry 1e-7 -> 1.000000000000000E-7
Float64To64 zero carry 1e-7 -> 9.999999999999999E-8
Float64To64 up carry 1e-7 -> 1.000000000000000E-7
Float64To64 down carry 1e-7 -> 9.999999999999999E-8
Float64To64 even carry -1e-7 -> -1.000000000000000E-7
Float64To64 up carry -1e-7 -> -9.999999999999999E-8
# 0x1.9999999999999p-4 = 0.09999999999999999167332731531132594682276248931884765625 (the float64 below 0.1)
Float64To64 even carry 0x1.9999999999999p-4 -> 0.09999999999999999
Float64To64 up carry 0x1.9999999999999p-4 -> 0.1000000000000000
Float64To64 up carry 1e23 -> 1.000000000000000E+23
# 1e-308 = 9.-309
Float64To64 even carry 1e-308 -> 9.999999999999999E-309
Float64To64 up carry 1e-308 -> 1.000000000000000E-308

Float64To64 even zero -0 -> -0
Float64To64 even zero 0 -> 0
Float64To64 down zero 0 -> 0
Float64To64 up zero -0 -> -0

Float64To64 even inf +Inf -> Infinity
Float64To64 even inf -Inf -> -Infinity
Float64To64 zero inf +Inf -> Infinity

Float64To64 even nan NaN -> NaN
Float64To64 zero nan NaN -> NaN
